m6A is an RNA modification. H04 uses sequence and nanopore signal features to score potential modification sites. This explorer helps you compare those predictions and identify candidates for follow-up.

The vocabulary

Site
A transcript ID, position and surrounding seven-base sequence. A site may be observed in several runs.
Read support / coverage
The number of reads covering a site in one run. Filtering is applied before aggregation.
Model score
A value from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate stronger model evidence for m6A. Scores are not guaranteed calibrated probabilities or measured modification fractions.
Predicted positive
A score at or above the selected threshold. The saved H04 threshold is .
Shared positive overlap
Jaccard similarity: positive in both cell lines divided by positive in either, considering only shared eligible sites. Empty positive unions are undefined.
Consistent candidate
All observed qualifying replicate scores are positive in one cell line and negative in the other, with at least two replicate groups in each.

How comparisons are made

  1. Filter each run to sites with at least the selected number of reads.
  2. Average qualifying technical-run scores within each named replicate group.
  3. Average those replicate scores with equal weight for each cell line.
  4. Require at least two qualifying replicates per cell line. Match transcript ID, position and sequence across the two groups.
  5. Compare scores and positive calls using the saved H04 threshold. Missing sites are excluded.
The overview threshold changes run-level summaries only. Comparisons and transcript calls always use the saved model threshold.

Versioned Ensembl IDs are harmonised only where at most one explicit version is observed. Original IDs are retained in transcript downloads. Known conflicting versions are kept separate.

Study scope and interpretation

These are descriptive model predictions. Expression, read depth, batch effects and shared sequence features can influence the patterns. Candidate differences have no p-values or multiple-testing correction. Confirm the experimental independence of named replicate groups before formal statistical testing.

The model’s training metadata does not resolve potential overlap with SG-NEx samples. This application is not an independent accuracy benchmark. Transcript isoforms may also represent the same genomic nucleotide.

Scatter plots show at most 2,000 sampled sites per comparison. Candidate lists contain at most 500 sites ranked by absolute score difference. Summary statistics use the complete eligible comparison. Transcript lookup retains every exported run–site observation at ≥10 reads.
